data.body: Epic complete: 19/19 children closed, every change through Gerrit (LLM-Review +1 AND Verified +1) and merged to main. AC evidence by line: (1) detected-by provenance at creation + bug_trends metrics lens landed (creation-seam capture, zero new required user input). (2) Deterministic pre-LLM gates live in CI/store: raw-git-write gate (d37e, 6739ea54fa), unread-config-field detection, wall-clock-assert gate (1e95, 9af88c3ada), AC-checkbox completeness close precheck (433c) with 330c box-flip normalization. (3) Transport typed end-to-end; declared asymmetries pinned by property tests; pagination deduplicated into the shared cursor iterator (ab7f, 30c522cde9). (4) reconcile-bridge/canary workflow bodies, probe harness, vote normalizer migrated to Python per strangler-fig. (5) Canary bug filing uses hardened dedup + documented bug-creation contract; dedup-key normalization fixed under a32a (1329). (6) Engine-layer validation placement advisory-enforced via project criterion in plan review. (7) rebar-debug + rebar-implement skills and the shared test-design standard encode the approved discipline upgrades. (8) review-plan on bugs runs a real review; Gerrit bugfix-size backstop blocks oversized unreviewed bug fixes (B2, 4527/de0deb0c89) — live-calibrated on 5 historical fixtures (4b54 attestation). (9) Comment-hygiene remediation landed with CI guard (b047). Post-epic bug dispositions: a32a/d32b/cabc closed with class + evidence; 05cb/18a4 reasoned deferrals (pre-existing, not epic deliverables); ee2a (gate skew regression caused by d37e+1e95 gates) fixed + closed (1338, 52cd34f169). Follow-ups filed: 51c1 (330c doc gap).
